subject: Unforeseen fire protection field condition: fire pump room clearance conflicting with the

messages.text: Sprinkler crew found the fire pump room clearance conflicting with the new equipment layout at Room 214; it's similar to the condition noted in last month's inspection log, but this one isn't shown on Fire Protection Detail 3/FP502. We would like this resolved ahead of the next work sequence. This condition will require a change order. No broader schedule impact is expected. A response within three business days would be appreciated.
Reroute to clear the conflict at Room 214 per the attached sketch; proceed once clearance is confirmed. This condition will require a change order.
